summary: Complete Universa-style deep OTM put backtesting framework built and verified. Core modules: option_pricing.py (Black-Scholes with delta-to-strike inversion, historical/EWMA volatility), strategy.py (monthly rolling deep OTM puts with 5 position sizing methods, 3 strike methods, fixed initial-NAV budget to avoid pro-cyclicality), analysis.py (20+ performance metrics, trade analysis, 6-panel visualization). Baseline backtest on CSI 300 (2010-2026): 5-delta monthly puts at 1% annual cost yields +0.25% CAGR improvement, +1.5% max drawdown reduction, 6.3% win rate, 18.4x payoff/cost ratio over 190 trades. Sensitivity analysis across 22 parameter combinations identifies d=3% + budget=2% as optimal (+3.9% DD reduction, +0.63% CAGR). Robustness verified across 4 indices (CSI 1000 best at +10.5% DD reduction) and 5 market regimes (crash periods best at +4-8%, trending markets worst at -3-4%).

All modules verified via direct execution. Option pricing: S=100/5-delta put correctly priced at K=91.37, premium=0.1224 (0.12% of spot). Full backtest assertion suite passed: 3980 trading days, spot CAGR 2.40%/nav CAGR 2.65%, spot MaxDD -46.70%/nav MaxDD -45.99%, annual cost 1.00%, win rate 6.3% (<15% assertion passed), payoff/cost 18.4x. All 6 assertions passed. Sensitivity results: 22 parameter combinations saved. Optimization/robustness: 7 optimization strategies + 4 indices + 5 market regimes saved to charts_v2/optimization_robustness.json.
